verdict.justification: The project is about developing an educational software to support the learning process of a Manejo Ambiental program for students of grade eleven at Institución Educativa Técnica La Marina in the area of Desechos de Producción Agropecuaria. The software uses Chamilo Learning Management System (LMS) to host and access different independent learning activities in various formats, and offers mechanisms for user management, group management, course management, collection management, and note generation from student-evaluation interactions.
